clue.text: Fire survivor is resting, having gone crazy

parts.note: someone resting is lying a-bed, in bed

indicators.note: letters gone crazy are thrown into a wild new order

explanation.surface: Someone who survived a blaze is now lying down, having lost their mind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crazy' rearranges GONE into NEGO. Abednego is one of the three men in the Book of Daniel thrown into the fiery furnace who came out unharmed.
explanation.definitionFit: In the biblical story, three companions walked unscathed out of Nebuchadnezzar's furnace; this is one of their names.

clue.text: Statue's representation is perceptive

indicators.note: a representation of the word re-presents its letters in a fresh order

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: A sculpture's depiction shows great insight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'representation' rearranges STATUE (the possessive 's adds no letter) into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A shrewd, sharp-witted person is quick to see what is going on.

clue.text: Pass by east European going round circuits

indicators.note: the two single letters sit on either side, wrapping around the laps

parts.note: E is the compass abbreviation for east
laps are circuits of a track

explanation.surface: Someone from eastern Europe drives round and round a track.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going round' puts the pair of Es outside LAPS, one at each end.
explanation.definitionFit: When time passes by, it goes on and is spent; the verb is a synonym.

clue.text: Statement of refusal or assent to murder

parts.note: a nod signals assent
to ice someone is slang for killing them

explanation.surface: Someone is asked whether to agree to a killing, refusing or consenting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'or' and 'to' are link words; the surface seems to offer a choice between refusing and agreeing, but the refusal is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The informal phrase means a flat no, an idiom for turning a request down.

clue.text: Means of transport for superior family

parts.note: something superior is good, of high quality
a strain is a line of descent, a family or breed

explanation.surface: Fine breeding is a way of getting ahead in life.
explanation.definitionFit: A freight train carries cargo by rail, so it is a way of moving things.

clue.text: Rodin sculpted many of Scandinavian origin

indicators.note: the word Rodin is shaped anew, as a sculptor reshapes material

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, taken as many

explanation.surface: The French sculptor made many figures of people from northern Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sculpted' rearranges RODIN into NORDI; Rodin was the French sculptor of The Thinker, which is the misdirection.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes peoples and things from the northern European countries such as Norway and Sweden.

clue.text: Extractor rendered lips sore

indicators.note: the words are rendered, made into something new, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A device for extracting juice left someone's mouth painful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rendered' rearranges LIPS SORE; rendering is also what is done to fat to extract oil, which suits the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A machine that squeezes seeds or olives to draw out their oil is a kind of extractor.

clue.text: Settlement of conflict is in hand

indicators.note: the conflict word is placed in the middle of the hand word

parts.note: a deal is a hand of cards dealt in a game
a fray is a fight or conflict

explanation.surface: Resolving a dispute is something we have control over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is' is a link word; 'in hand' reads as an idiom for under control, hiding the container.
explanation.definitionFit: Paying off a cost or bill is settling it, so the noun means payment or settlement.

clue.text: Agreement on old musical work

parts.note: to act in concert is to act in agreement

explanation.surface: Musicians reached a deal about playing a classic piece.
explanation.definitionFit: A composition for a solo instrument and orchestra is a type of musical work.

clue.text: Rip parachute revealing well of emotion

parts.note: to rip is to tear
to parachute supplies is to drop them from the air

explanation.surface: A torn parachute reveals deep feelings in the jumper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revealing' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A single drop shed from the eye wells up when someone is moved, hence a well of emotion.

clue.text: Chemical wrongly spelled on file

indicators.note: the words are spelt out wrongly, so their letters come out in a different order

explanation.surface: The name of a substance was entered incorrectly in the records.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrongly spelled' rearranges ON FILE.
explanation.definitionFit: An alkene, an unsaturated hydrocarbon such as ethylene, is a chemical compound.

clue.text: Good man caught in plague provides a precedent

indicators.note: the saint and the catch are placed in the middle of the plague word

parts.note: to plague someone is to tease or pester them
ST, short for saint, is the crossword good man
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A virtuous man trapped in an epidemic sets an example for later.
explanation.walkthrough: 'provides a' is linking matter; 'plague' looks like a noun for disease but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A legal action whose outcome sets a rule for later similar cases is a precedent.

clue.text: Screw up credit facility

parts.note: CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit
facility can mean ease, as in doing something with facility

explanation.surface: A bank mishandles a loan arrangement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'facility' suggests a loan facility, but here it means ease or skill.
explanation.definitionFit: To screw up paper or cloth is to crumple it, making folds.

clue.text: Peril Annie unleashed in the outdoors

indicators.note: the letters are let off the leash and run loose into a new order

explanation.surface: A woman called Annie is let loose outside, in danger.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unleashed' rearranges PERIL ANNIE. The French phrase is used of painting outdoors rather than in a studio.
explanation.definitionFit: The borrowed French phrase literally means in full open air, so outside.

clue.text: Many marshals handle engine part

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, taken as many
to marshal troops is to draw them up in ranks, so ranks is a verb here
a haft is the handle of a knife or axe

explanation.surface: Numerous military officers take hold of a piece of machinery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'marshals' looks like a noun for officers but is a verb meaning arranges.
explanation.definitionFit: The rotating shaft that turns pistons' up-and-down motion into rotation is a component of an engine.

clue.text: Check straps of women's underwear

parts.note: to scan is to check or examine
ties are straps or fastenings

explanation.surface: Someone inspects the shoulder straps on lingerie.
explanation.definitionFit: The informal term means skimpy knickers worn by women, a kind of underwear.

clue.text: Unattached girl's island

parts.note: Di is a girl's name, so the girl's is Di's
Crete is the large Greek island

explanation.surface: A single woman owns a Mediterranean island.
explanation.definitionFit: Separate, distinct things are not joined to each other.

clue.text: Spill the beans about select sport

indicators.note: the confess word goes about, around the select word

parts.note: to sing is slang for informing or confessing
to cull is to select or pick out

explanation.surface: Someone reveals a secret about a chosen game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spill the beans' reads as revealing a secret but is underworld slang for informing; 'about' signals the wrap.
explanation.definitionFit: Rowing with oars, often in a light racing boat, is a water sport.

clue.text: Animal is cold in the country

indicators.note: the cold word is put in the middle of the country

parts.note: China is the country meant
a chill is a cold feeling

explanation.surface: A creature finds itself chilled within a nation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is' is a link word; 'the country' looks vague but must be a specific nation.
explanation.definitionFit: This small South American rodent, prized for soft fur, is a creature.

clue.text: Keep fit class gets a small amount of money

parts.note: PE, physical education, is keep-fit exercise
a set is a class or group of pupils

explanation.surface: An exercise class gets a little money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gets' is a link word. The peseta was Spain's currency before the euro.
explanation.definitionFit: The old Spanish coin, worth little, was a unit of currency.

clue.text: Offend poor legendary sailor

parts.note: to offend can mean to sin or transgress
poor quality is bad

explanation.surface: A sea legend behaves badly and gives offence.
explanation.definitionFit: The voyager of the Arabian Nights tales is a famous seafarer of story.

clue.text: Respect soldiers having come round on any occasion

indicators.note: the soldiers come round, wrapping around the other piece

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, are soldiers
ever means at any time, on any occasion

explanation.surface: Soldiers who keep returning are always honoured.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having come round' signals that the soldiers enclose the other piece; RE, Royal Engineers, is a British army corps.
explanation.definitionFit: To hold someone in deep esteem is to honour them.

clue.text: Diamonds left in US city with care

indicators.note: the gem and the side are placed inside the city

parts.note: NY is New York
ice is slang for diamonds

explanation.surface: Gems are abandoned in New York with caution.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something precisely and delicately is doing it carefully.

clue.text: Little interest with cat's umbilicus

parts.note: L is an abbreviation for little
i is the usual symbol for interest in finance
feline means of or like a cat

explanation.surface: Few people care about a cat's navel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: The navel's cord once carried nourishment to the unborn, a literal line keeping it alive.

clue.text: One meets old secret police chief in Europe

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
Lavrentiy Beria ran Stalin's secret police

explanation.surface: A man encounters a former Soviet security boss on the continent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'meets' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: The peninsula shared by Spain and Portugal lies in the south-west of the continent.

clue.text: Beer in black package is fit for trade

indicators.note: the beer goes in the middle of the black word
the black word packages, wraps around, the beer

parts.note: sable is black in heraldry
ale is a beer

explanation.surface: Beer in black packaging is ready to sell.
explanation.walkthrough: Sable is the heraldic word for black; 'in' and 'package' both signal the wrap.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods suitable to be sold are marketable.

clue.text: Transport small shelf

parts.note: a ledge is a narrow shelf

explanation.surface: A little shelf is moved.
explanation.definitionFit: A sledge carries people or goods over snow, so it is a vehicle.

clue.text: Material making instrument perish

parts.note: an organ is a musical instrument
to perish is to die

explanation.surface: Fabric was used to make an instrument that then failed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'making' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: This fine stiff muslin is a cotton fabric.
